double_fill.law: per drink: chance = P(rand()%100 < floor(randLimited(Vit)/2)) for health (Energy for mana); success doubles the amount; rejuvs excluded
double_fill.uses_stat: current total Vitality / Energy (STAT_VITALITY / STAT_ENERGY incl. items)

delivery.frames: 25 fps; total amount <<8 (1/256 points) is laid on a timed stat list (state healthpot/manapot) as a per-frame regen of total/len
delivery.second_potion: same state: duration EXTENDS (remaining + len) and the per-frame rate is recomputed as (new total + remaining old) / (remaining + len). Totals add; the rate does not stack. A smaller potion on top of a larger one SLOWS the fill
delivery.second_potion_grade: MODEL-VERIFIED (D2MOO pSpell03 + Arreat 'will not cause you to replenish life any faster' + PureDiablo averaging example)
delivery.cast_interaction: drinking is an item-use request with no player-mode gate and no animation in the code path (ItemMode.cpp sub_6FC49220); it neither interrupts nor delays a cast
delivery.cast_interaction_grade: INFERRED (single code source, by absence; no community statement found)
delivery.hit_cancels: no: the potion stat list is removed only at its expiry frame; nothing in the damage path (SUnitDmg.cpp) removes healthpot/manapot
delivery.hit_cancels_grade: INFERRED (code by absence; Arreat's advice to 'run away long enough for them to heal fully' is consistent, not explicit)
delivery.cooldown: none in code; the limit is the belt and inventory
delivery.cooldown_grade: INFERRED (no use-delay in pSpell03 or the belt-use path)

rules: only the bottom row (slots 0-3) is hotkeyed (1-4)
drinking a bottom-row potion drops the potions above it down that column (ItemMode.cpp sub_6FC49140; PureDiablo 'like a vending machine')

picking up a potion auto-belts it into a column holding the same potion type, else into an empty bottom slot if Misc.txt autobelt=1 (D2Inventory.cpp INVENTORY_GetFreeBeltSlot; PureDiablo 'Picking up potions restocks the belt')
inventory potions do NOT refill the belt automatically; shift-click moves them (Arreat potions page)
